Before anything else this morning: open Chrome Incognito, log in as madeat2am.ai@gmail.com, open a FRESH reauth link (the 9 Jul one is stale), approve all scopes, copy the full redirect URL from the address bar, and paste it back here. recommendations.action: Recommend Chris picks leave balances as the first build: it is the biggest UX gap (a manager in Singapore cannot answer the question of how many days an employee has left), the schema already supports the type column on leave_requests, and it is pure additive with no new infra and no new external dependencies. Concretely: (1) add a leave_balances table with company_id, user_id, leave_type, year, total_days, used_days and accrued_days plus FKs to companies and users; (2) a Leave entitlement panel in Company Settings where managers set per-type year totals per employee; (3) a My Balances widget on the employee Dashboard showing each type with remaining days; (4) a year-end carryover rule applied on Jan 1 via a scheduled routine. Half a day's work for the schema plus API, plus a UI pass. After it ships, immediately queue the next Tier 1, recommended mobile PWA clock-in since no 5 is the next-biggest UX win and PWA beats native install for the SG worker demographic. If Chris still cannot pick today, ship the smallest Tier 1, time-log validation, purely to break the deadlock and prove momentum.
